title: Fix the Function Missing a Return
description: The program should define a function that returns the square of a number.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 25, the square of 5.
actualProblem: square() is declared to return an int but never actually executes a return statement. The function's return value is therefore indeterminate (garbage), so square(5) does not reliably produce 25.
explanation: A C function declared with a non-void return type must use a return statement to send a value back to its caller. Without one, the value the caller receives is undefined.
